title: Refund Share by Days Late - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders Delivery Service Levels
content:
For a late-delivery fee refund on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, the days late are counted in calendar days from the promised date to the completed date, and the refund share starts from the share the days late set.

| Days late (promised date to completed date) | Refund share starts from |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 80% |
| 3 or more, but fewer than 5 | 40% |
| Exactly 2 | 30% |
| 1 | Not raised by this schedule |

### Both sides of each threshold

| Days late | Share starts from |
|---|---|
| 1 | Not raised |
| 2 | 30% |
| 3 | 40% |
| 4 | 40% |
| 5 | 80% |

**Example (hypothetical).** An Expedited Ship-to-Home order promised for 3 March and completed on 7 March is 4 days late; its refund share starts from 40%.
